GPT-4o (4o) on the ChatGPT iOS app has a maximum context window (token limit) of up to 128,000 tokens per chat/conversation. However, each single response ("output") from the model is limited to about 4,096 tokens. The same 128k context window applies across iOS, web, and desktop apps, as this is a core model limitation, not a platform-specific limit[10][14]. 

Message frequency limits are separate. For ChatGPT Plus users, you typically get up to 80 GPT-4o messages every 3 hours; Teams/Enterprise tiers raise these caps (e.g., Team: 160/3hrs; Enterprise: higher or negotiable). These limits apply regardless of whether you use the iOS app, web, or desktop, as they're account-based, not device-based[14][12].

Key points:
- Context window: 128,000 tokens (all input+output in the conversation)[10][14]
- Output limit per reply: ~4,096 tokens[14][17]
- iOS app has the same token policy as the web
- Plus plan: 80 messages/3 hours (GPT-4o); Team/Enterprise can access more[14][12]

Caveat: While you can include up to 128k tokens in a conversation, extremely long chats may operate less reliably on mobile (due to memory), and image uploads also consume tokens based on their complexity[14]. These limits are current as of August 2025, but always check official OpenAI documentation for the most current policies.
